mapper.select: select distinct mn.${value} as dbValue,com.C_Name as label from Settlement_First_Audit mn left join SYS_Company com on com.C_Id=mn.${value} where mn.status=1 and mn.del_flag=1
select distinct mn.${value} as dbValue,u.U_Name as label from Settlement_First_Audit mn left join SYS_User u on u.U_ID=mn.${value} where mn.status=1 and mn.del_flag=1
select distinct mn.${value} as dbValue from Settlement_First_Audit mn where mn.status=1 and mn.del_flag=1
select distinct mn.${value} as dbValue,p.P_Name as label from Settlement_First_Audit mn left join Pre_Project p on p.P_Id=mn.project_id where mn.status=1 and mn.del_flag=1
select distinct mn.${value} as dbValue,con.Con_Name as label from Settlement_First_Audit mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.contract_id where mn.status=1 and mn.del_flag=1

select mn.*, p.P_Name as projectName, con.Con_Name as contractName,con.Con_Money_Total as contractTotalMoney, con.Con_Party_B_Id as contractCompanyId, c3.C_Name as contractCompanyName, con.Con_Bid_Amt AS contractControlPrice, c1.C_Name as sfaCostConsultantUnitName, c2.C_Name as sfaSupervisionUnitName from Settlement_First_Audit mn left join Pre_Project p on p.P_Id=mn.project_id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.contract_id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.sfa_cost_consultant_unit left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.sfa_supervision_unit left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=con.Con_Party_B_Id where mn.id = #{id} and mn.status=1 and mn.del_flag=1
select mn.* from Con_EC mn left join multi_contract_con_ec mce on mce.uuid=mn.multi_contract_con_ec_id where mn.Con_Id=#{contractId} and mce.state=7
